basic_info.description: Live amongst architectural grandeur in this captivating two story Edwardian home on one of Noe Valley's most coveted streets - offering timeless architectural bones with exciting dreamhouse'' potential. With 1,865 +/- square feet of living space, this well-maintained 1909 residence includes 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and sits on a generous 3,107 square foot lot. A beautifully preserved Edwardian faade with decorative cornice, dentil molding, and bay windows provides classic SF curb appeal. Inside, soaring 9'+ ceilings, original hardwood floors with inlay, gumwood trim, coved ceilings, and vintage built-ins await your thoughtful updates. The home features formal living and dining rooms, plus a family room adjacent to a sunny eat-in kitchen with Wedgewood stove - a perfect canvas for updating to modern open-concept living. An expansive north-facing deck overlooks a beautifully landscaped garden with patio. Upstairs features 4 spacious bedrooms and 1 full bath, with potential to reconfigure into a 3BR/2BA layout with primary suite. A spacious garage includes parking, laundry, a quarter bath, and ample storage. Located steps from the vibrant 24th St. corridor in SF's sunniest neighborhood, w/ a 94 Walk Score - this classic Noe Valley treasure is a hidden gem ready for its next chapter.
